## Abstract

This book presents a comprehensive overview of mobile software development, emphasizing fundamental concepts and common challenges across various platforms rather than specific technologies. It highlights the evolution of mobile devices from single-purpose hardware to versatile programming environments, expanding opportunities for personalized features and enterprise applications. The author aims to make the complexities of mobile development more accessible to English-speaking developers, drawing on extensive teaching experience in Finland.
